notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]The entire game has been re-lit to accommodate for OpenGL Rendering -- Allowing for Linux and Mac version releases. (coming very soon)
[*]New graphic options available to accommodate for lower end systems.
[url=http://apt-game.com/images/graphics1.png]Highest Settings FPS[/url]
[url=http://apt-game.com/images/graphics2.png]Lowest Settings FPS[/url]
[*]Options to disable the player model have been added.
[*]Options for shadow quality added.
[*]The Jump Jet particle effects have been removed.  It was more annoying than useful.  Instead, there is a new flight path ribbon following player color choices. Option to be disabled.
[/list]

notes.title: Coming Patch notes and APT Future
notes.notes:
[h1]Immanent Changes[/h1]

[list]
    [*]The entire game has been re-lit to accommodate for OpenGL Rendering -- Allowing for Linux and Mac version releases.
    [*]New graphic options available to accommodate for lower end systems.
[url=http://apt-game.com/images/graphics1.png]Highest Settings FPS[/url]
[url=http://apt-game.com/images/graphics2.png]Lowest Settings FPS[/url]
    [*]Options to disable the player model have been added.
 [*]Options for shadow quality added.
[*]The Jump Jet particle effects have been removed.  It was more annoying than useful.  Instead, there is a new flight path ribbon following player color choices. Option to be disabled.
[/list]
We will be deploying this patch within the next day or two.

The memory problems are still being looked in to and will have a fix ASAP.

[h1]The future of APT[/h1]

APT is getting story!
In the very near future, we will add a full story.  Learn about Alice and her surroundings.  Why is she there?

Free content updates!  We will be adding more levels, more abilities and level elements to come and we won't be charging for them.  APT is RIP Studios' first release and we're giving it everything we've got.   We hope you enjoy it and future updates.

notes.title: New patch live on steam!~
notes.notes:
I'd like everyone to check out the new beta build on steam.

Beta 2.0 Changes--

[list]
    [*]Tutorial cut scenes now skippable.
    [*]Crashes caused by quickly navigating cards or leaderboards fixed
    [*]Fixed problem with leaderboards displaying times over 1 minute.
[*]Added animations per scored rank
[*]7 new levels
[*]Fixed bug where tutorial would not give the camera back to the player.
[*]New area for always displaying your rank position on leaderboards (WIP)
[/list]



NEW CHALLENGES

Creators challenge
TetherShot Shootout

Have fun!
